ms.report:
I was very busy and had some trouble accessing my account here.
The Site/Service is live and operational since some time, I just moved it to a nicer domain.
Everything is finished and working, you can check it out yourself here:
https://cardanoinsight.io

One reviewer on the last submit said:
"Well its a tricky situation now/ Technically you failed the proposal in my opinion, bringing this up 3 years later.
There surely was way to contact the Catalyst Team and update the milestone deadlines before.
I',m fine with the fact the proposal did not have the promised impact nor delivery date
Considering all the other proposals had to do it, not sure how this did not."

-- Let's maybe include one important fact:
I stated that the project will be finished within a very short amount of time,
and after that some people kept re-submitting me milestone-stuff for weeks and months.
In the other one for example: I said I need 2 weeks, and you kept me resubmitted milestone stuff for 6+ weeks etc.
MAYBE someone also respects the time-line of the Developer?!
I reached out to everyone I know, Danny and other people I know. Was without success,
so at some point I just needed to continue with my other commitments in my life.

So, long story short, things where not perfect from both sides, and we do not need to go through everything.
Both Projects are finished, went live some time ago, and the community uses them since years.
I just had the time to get access back to this portal and leave a message.
Thank you!
